status: Real bundler diagnostics identified vendor ELF rewriting; immutable resource relocation awaits fresh hosted AppImage proof.

observed.compiler_result: Actual Tauri release application compiled successfully in 2m57s.
observed.bundle_result: AppImage failed with only 'failed to run linuxdeploy'; underlying tool stdout/stderr were absent.

upstream_source.binding: The installed CLI's published Cargo.lock pins this exact bundler version/checksum; the downloaded source archive matched it.
upstream_source.cause_of_missing_output: CLI bundle.rs maps verbosity0 to spawned log_level=Error. linux/appimage/linuxdeploy.rs then calls Command::output(), discards stdout/stderr and emits only the generic failure. One --verbose selects output_ok(), which preserves the actual tool failure and emits its output through the CLI logger.
upstream_source.fuse: The pinned bundler already supplies APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1 and --appimage-extract-and-run. A missing FUSE package is not an evidenced cause.

resource_preservation.observed_cause: linuxdeploy scans bundled browser ELFs under usr/lib/Numera Browser/engine, fails Camoufox's libgkcodecs dependency and attempts strip/RPATH changes on immutable vendor bytes.
resource_preservation.scan_scope: listSharedLibraries recursively scans usr/lib; listExecutables scans immediate usr/bin. Dependency exclusions do not preserve ELF byte identity.
resource_preservation.tauri_file_map: Pinned bundler2.10.4 uses target-package-path -> source. It removes a leading slash and recursively copies directories for linux.appimage.files and linux.deb.files. Standard bundle.resources maps to usr/lib/productName.
resource_preservation.resource_resolver: Tauri2.12.4 desktop.rs blob109f0f923f0fe5b26c9dbf607193409bd91cc6cc delegates to tauri-utils/platform.rs blob9a148d2eb82bd8c82cf3958d75b6a189b7d597b1. AppImage resource_dir uses APPDIR/usr/lib/package_info.name; codegen/context.rs blob2f4042c8ab33f876de4e224a00fb5902137e8671 sets that name from productName.
resource_preservation.change: Place the complete immutable engine tree at usr/share/Numera Browser/engine for AppImage and Debian files maps. Linux lifecycle resolves only the sibling share/productName from a validated usr/lib/productName resource path. Existing portable, macOS, Windows and legacy installed resource lookup remain available.
resource_preservation.policy: No dependency exclusions, vendor mutations, missing backends, installer omissions, receipt changes or wall/idle increases.
resource_preservation.pending: Existing layout and lifecycle controls plus a fresh hosted AppImage build must verify this relocation; local system libraries are insufficient for a full AppImage build.

implementation.behavior: The actual Tauri command uses --verbose and the native owned capture boundary. It preserves wall1800s/idle300s/cleanup10s and a16MiB output budget. Complete bounded transcripts are redacted before retention and before console tails are clipped to16KiB per stream at UTF8 boundaries. Actual nonzero exits and failed capture remain errors.
implementation.scope: Pinned tools, Ubuntu packages, AppImage/Debian and other native bundle requirements, signature policy and installer verification remain unchanged.

validation.red: A temporary no-op executor failed the existing case because a real failed bundle-tool process was accepted.
validation.green: The same case passed: actual compiled Rust child exit7 and a linuxdeploy missing-library diagnostic were retained; a synthetic password was removed; large Unicode output respected the console tail bound; a successful child remained successful.
validation.reported: 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 642 filtered out; 0.30 seconds. No test names/counts were added.
validation.limitation: This validates diagnostic capture with real native subprocesses. It does not establish a local AppImage build or identify the hidden hosted prerequisite failure. The fresh hosted lane must provide that evidence before another behavior change.
